title: One cell divides into two
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: After DNA replication, mitosis separates sister chromatids. With normal separation, each daughter in this model receives one copy of each chromosome: two per cell.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: After DNA replication, mitosis separates sister chromatids. With normal separation, each daughter in this model receives one copy of each chromosome: two per cell.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A model cell has two chromosomes. After ordinary mitosis and cytokinesis, how many chromosomes are in each daughter cell? After DNA replication, mitosis separates sister chromatids. With normal separation, each daughter in this model receives one copy of each chromosome: two per cell.

Recall: A model cell has four chromosomes and divides by ordinary mitosis. How many chromosomes per daughter? Normal mitosis distributes one copy of each of the four chromosomes to each daughter cell.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.

recall.question: A model cell has four chromosomes and divides by ordinary mitosis. How many chromosomes per daughter?
recall.why: Normal mitosis distributes one copy of each of the four chromosomes to each daughter cell.
